Popular questions Rates Complaints Reservations Reviews Cancelling Offer View all frequently asked questions Popular questions How do I make a reservation? On Bedandbreakfast.eu, you can book B&Bs using non-binding reservation requests or directly confirmed bookings. On the page of the B&B, you can see which reservation method applies. Then, follow the steps on the page to book the B&B of your choice. Do you need help with this? Please feel free to contact us . How do I know if my reservation is final? If you have made a reservation request at a B&B, you will have received a copy of the request by email. In direct contact with the Host, both the guest and the Host confirm the reservation before it is final. I have not yet received a response to my reservation request. A Host should respond to your reservation request within 24 hours. Please note that there may be different time zones, or the Host may not have internet access at that time. It is also possible that your reservation request may have escaped the attention of the Host or that something else has gone wrong. We recommend the following: In your email program, check the spam or junk e-mail folder. It is possible that the answer from the Host ended up in this folder by mistake. Try to reach the Bed & Breakfast by phone. A telephone number is often stated on the presentation page or in the confirmation of your reservation request. Can’t reach the B&B? Please try again later or start looking for another B&B. Please leave a message to let the B&B know that you are cancelling the reservation request. Can I cancel my reservation free of charge? The rules for cancellation differ per B&B. In most cases, you can find the cancellation conditions on the presentation page under the ‘Conditions’ section. A Host can also state the cancellation conditions in the e-mail contact before the reservation is finalised. How can I write a review? If you stayed at a B&B booked through Bedandbreakfast.eu, you will automatically receive an email the day after your check out. You can write a review on Bedandbreakfast.eu following the link in this email. Still have questions?
